description: Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, billing visibility, and read-only visibility into account resources.
notes: Billing, Cost Explorer, and Budgets are three distinct AWS permission surfaces despite reading as one concept ('cost management') in the brief — each required its own policy.

AWSBudgetsReadOnlyAccess allows viewing budgets but not creating/editing them. If the Finance Manager needs to create new budget alerts independently, substitute AWSBudgetsActionsWithAWSResourceControlAccess.
